name: Secret Barrel
source_text: Inflict Direct Damage to your opponent's Life Points equal to the total number of cards on your opponent's side of the field and in your opponent's hand x 200 points.
notes: Counts opponent monsters, Spell/Traps, Field Spell and hand.
